roleTitle: Implementation Project Manager, Fleet Telematics Service
jobDescription: The fleet telematics service tracks delivery vehicles for logistics customers and feeds their dispatch desks. The Implementation Project Manager takes customer implementations into live operation: has brought customer fleets live on the service, runs the cut-over from the customer's previous system, owns the hypercare period after go-live and handles the incidents raised by the customer's dispatchers, coordinates the customer's device installation schedule with the field engineering partner, and documents implementation boundaries. The role reports to the head of customer delivery and works with the delivery team's implementation leads, the field engineering partner and each customer's dispatch desk.
requirements: Has brought customer fleets live on the service and run the cut-over from the customer's previous system.
Owns the hypercare period after go-live and handles incidents raised by the customer's dispatchers.
Coordinates the customer's device installation schedule with the field engineering partner.
Runs customer pilots with a documented configuration and a pilot report.
Produces the implementation plan and documents the pilot's limitations and hand-over conditions.

evidence.text: Ran the pre-implementation pilot programme for the fleet telematics service, configuring the demonstration tenant for six prospective logistics customers and running a two-week pilot with each customer's pilot vehicles.
Coordinated the installation of pilot devices on each customer's pilot vehicles with the field engineering partner, keeping the installation schedule for the pilot vehicles only.

The cut-over to live operation, the device installation across each customer's full fleet and the hypercare period were run by the delivery team's implementation leads after the contract was signed; I did not take part in those stages.

Wrote the pilot report and the implementation plan handed to the delivery team for each customer, listing the demonstration tenant's limitations, open configuration questions and the hand-over conditions.
About three years on the pilot programme covered tenant configuration, pilot delivery, pilot-device installation scheduling, pilot reports and implementation plans for prospective customers.
Work sample: the pilot report and implementation plan for one regional carrier, with the demonstration tenant's configuration identifiers and the pilot vehicle list as a verification trail.

Recruiter screen: candidate said he had 'brought six logistics fleets live on the service' and 'ran the cut-overs'; asked about hypercare, he said the delivery team 'did the night shifts' and that his pilots 'were the real implementation'.

Hiring manager pre-read: the agency summary reads 'six fleet implementations taken live, cut-over and hypercare included'; the head of customer delivery wants someone who has actually run a cut-over and a hypercare period, so the packet should say who ran each stage.

propositions.text: The candidate ran the pre-implementation pilot programme, configuring the demonstration tenant for six prospective customers and running two-week pilots with their pilot vehicles.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the pilot report document the pilots and their tenant.

propositions.text: The candidate coordinated pilot-device installation with the field engineering partner and wrote the pilot report and implementation plan for each customer.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the pilot scheduling and the plans.

propositions.text: The candidate brought customer fleets live on the service and ran the cut-overs and hypercare periods.
propositions.rationale: The resume confines the candidate to the demonstration tenant and pilot vehicles and places cut-over, full-fleet installation and hypercare with the delivery team's implementation leads; the screen remark that the pilots were the real implementation is his own characterisation.

gold.expectedGap: The materials document pilots in the demonstration tenant; they do not document the candidate bringing a fleet live, running a cut-over or owning a hypercare period.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the stage the resume names: pre-contract pilots in the demonstration tenant; cut-over, full-fleet installation and hypercare belonged to the delivery team.
followUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has ever run a cut-over or a hypercare period himself, for which customer and in what role.
